card.name: Word-start pieces like St, unst, overst
card.fires_on: The opening letters of a word split into pieces, mostly "st" or "unst" or "overst" (stumps, stomach, stinging, staking, St. George), and "Ap" before oE in ApoE.

modes.label: St- word starts
modes.description: The piece "St" or "st" begins a word that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: - Decreased appetite -<< St>>omach pain - Weight loss

modes.description: A prefixed word is split so the stem begins with "st" or "precip".

modes.description: The piece "Ap" starts the gene name ApoE after a reference bracket.
